apps.localizedDescription:
Yattee 2 is in the works! A new version of the app is being built with a refreshed experience. It pairs with the new Yattee Server — a self-hosted backend powered by yt-dlp that supports 1000+ sites.

Features:

• Native user interface built with SwiftUI with customization settings.
• Player queue and history.
• Player component with custom controls, gestures and support for 4K playback.
• Fullscreen, Picture in Picture and background audio playback.

versions.localizedDescription:
Bug fixes:

• Log and alert when hardware decoding falls back to software mid-playback.
• Reload the avfoundation audio output when it restarts while paused.
• Keep the display link paused while the app is in the background.
• Open SwiftData and TipKit stores after didFinishLaunching on iOS.
